data.keyword: How does the GEO Stack work?

result.keyword: How does the GEO Stack work?
result.markdown:
The **GEO Stack** is a framework used in *Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)* — basically the newer discipline focused on how content gets **found, extracted, and cited by AI systems** like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

One of the most referenced versions is the **five-layer GEO Stack**, which describes how AI systems decide whether to use your content in an answer. [thegeolab.net](https://thegeolab.net/geo-stack/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

## The GEO Stack (simple breakdown)

Think of it as a **pipeline from “your page exists” → “AI actually uses it in an answer.”**

### 1. Retrieval Probability
This is the entry gate.

Before anything else, your content has to be:
- Indexed by search engines
- Relevant enough to be retrieved in candidate results
- Often already ranking in at least the top ~30 results

If you fail here, AI systems never even “see” your page.

---

### 2. Extractability
Once your page is retrieved, the AI asks:
> “Can I easily pull useful information from this?”

This depends on:
- Clear headings and structure
- Short, self-contained paragraphs
- Explicit answers (not buried content)
- Clean HTML / readable formatting

If content is messy or ambiguous, it gets ignored even if it ranks.

---

### 3. Entity Reinforcement
Here the system checks:
> “Do I understand *what this is about* and who/what it’s connected to?”

AI models rely heavily on **entities** (brands, people, concepts).

Strong GEO content:
- Repeats key entities consistently
- Uses clear naming (no ambiguity)
- Connects concepts to known topics

This improves confidence that your page is “about the right thing.”

---

### 4. Structural Authority
Now the AI evaluates trust signals in structure and context:

- Schema markup (FAQ, Article, Organization, etc.)
- Citations and references
- Internal linking structure
- Clear authorship and publication context

This layer is about:  
> “Does this look like a reliable source I can quote?”

---

### 5. System Memory
The most advanced layer.

This is about whether systems:
- Repeatedly see your brand/content across sources
- Remember it as a trusted entity over time
- Reinforce it across multiple retrieval cycles

It’s not just one page — it’s **your overall presence in the AI ecosystem**.

---

## The key idea behind the GEO Stack

All layers are **sequential and dependent**:

If Retrieval fails → nothing else matters  
If Extractability is weak → AI can’t use your content  
If Entity signals are unclear → AI misinterprets you  
If Authority is weak → AI won’t cite you  
If Memory is strong → you become a “default source”

[thegeolab.net](https://thegeolab.net/geo-stack/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

## How it differs from classic SEO thinking

Traditional SEO asks:
- “Can I rank?”

GEO Stack asks:
- “Can I be *retrieved, understood, extracted, and cited by an AI answer engine*?”

So instead of just ranking pages, you're optimizing for:
- inclusion in AI-generated answers
- citation frequency
- semantic clarity at the chunk (section) level

---

If you want, I can map the GEO Stack directly onto your own website or content strategy so you can see where you’d actually improve first.
